verdict.rationale: An interactive API reference is a fair axis for a developer framework like Mastra, but the evidence shows no explorable API reference with runnable examples. Studio is an agent-testing interface (adjacent), llms.txt and docs.md are static documentation, templates are clonable projects, and all OpenAPI/Swagger probes returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
